description: Read-only recorded atlas changes strictly after since, oldest first. No key or Record API quota. Example: {"since":"2026-11-01T00:00:00Z","domain":"example.com"}.

cursor.description: Copy nextCursor; keep since, domain and limit unchanged.

domain.description: Optional domain or http(s) URL, matching host and subdomains.

limit.description: Maximum items to return, from 1 to 50. Default 20.

since.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z; optional 1–3 fractional second digits.

name: list_changes
title: List public changes
